acceptanceCriteria.text: The greenfield View base class is OBSERVER-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: it subscribes to a Model's IOR-keyed event + re-renders via renderSelf() on notify; there is NO reload/poll path in the base. In the new repo: 0 location.reload, 0 polling-for-freshness. A view that reloads/polls => RED (so the 13/94-subscribe retrofit cannot recur).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The greenfield Model base class owns state + a per-object IOR-keyed CHANGE-EVENT (emits on mutation); EVERY domain class (File/Folder/Repository/...) extends it, so change-events exist BY CONSTRUCTION. A data-bag class (no behaviour/events) is unrepresentable => a data-bag class => RED.
